evidence.claim: A pod worker records the time termination begins and marks the pod as started terminating.
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: terminatingAt is set when zero, startedTerminating is set true, and the last pod update is requeued.
result.interpretation: The termination start time is recorded once and is not reset by later kill requests.

evidence.claim: A shorter termination grace-period override is accepted and changes the effective grace period.
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: The function replaces the current grace period when the supplied override is smaller and returns true when the stored value changes.
result.interpretation: A 10-second request can shorten an existing 60-second grace period to 10 seconds.

evidence.claim: A shortened grace period causes the pod worker to cancel the current pod sync.
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: UpdatePod stores the effective grace period, sets the KillPodOptions override, detects that the grace period was shortened, and calls status.cancelFn().
result.interpretation: The new 10-second termination update causes the current pod sync to be cancelled/reprocessed.

evidence.claim: The current SyncTerminatingPod implementation replaces the pod-worker context with context.TODO().
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: The incoming context is replaced with klog.NewContext(context.TODO(), logger). The source contains TODO #113606 concerning connecting the incoming context.
result.interpretation: The pod-worker cancellation does not propagate through this replacement context to the currently running termination operation.

evidence.claim: The pod termination context and grace-period override are passed to the container runtime.
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: killPod calls containerRuntime.KillPod(ctx, pod, p, gracePeriodOverride).
result.interpretation: The effective grace-period override reaches the runtime termination path.

evidence.claim: The runtime applies the grace-period override directly to container termination and passes it to StopContainer.
evidence.verification: Inspected the pinned Kubernetes source at the cited path and line range; the cited statements were verified directly in the source.

result.observed: killContainer assigns the override to gracePeriod and calls runtimeService.StopContainer with that value.
result.interpretation: A subsequent termination operation receives the shortened 10-second override; the code does not subtract elapsed time from terminatingAt.
